maintainer_note: Community-maintained profile (exotic edition). Arch userland (pacman) with OpenRC instead of systemd -- no hostnamectl/systemctl anywhere in this file. Package/service names inherited from arch.json where OpenRC does not change them; samba/nfs OpenRC service names should be validated against the current artix-openrc-base package set before relying on them in production. Contributions welcome!

packages.module_search: pacman -Ss '^freedomnas-module-' | awk '/^[^ ]/ {{split($1, a, "/"); n = a[2]; v = $2; next}} {{sub(/^ +/, ""); print n "\t" v "\t" $0}}'
packages.module_installed: pacman -Qs '^freedomnas-module-' | awk '/^[^ ]/ {{split($1, a, "/"); n = a[2]; v = $2; next}} {{sub(/^ +/, ""); print n "\t" v "\t" $0}}'

openrc.module_search: pacman -Ss '^freedomnas-module-' | awk '/^[^ ]/ {{split($1, a, "/"); n = a[2]; v = $2; next}} {{sub(/^ +/, ""); print n "\t" v "\t" $0}}' | awk -F '\t' '$1 ~ /-(dinit|runit|s6)$/ {{next}} $1 ~ /-openrc$/ {{b = $1; sub(/-openrc$/, "", b); own[b] = $0; next}} {{base[$1] = $0}} END {{for (b in own) print own[b]; for (n in base) if (!(n in own)) print base[n]}}' | sort

packages._note_modules: module_search / module_installed: community modules are the packages named freedomnas-module-<id>; one line per package: name<TAB>version<TAB>description. module_search reads the local package index (update_cache refreshes it). Artix's module packages come in one variant per init (freedomnas-module-containers-openrc, -dinit, -runit), each depending on that init's service packages (docker-openrc…): by_init keeps, for the running init, its own variant of each module and a plain package only for a module without one, and its module_pattern reads the module id without the init's suffix.

power_button.rule:
# FreedomNAS: a press of the power button shuts the NAS down.
event=button/power.*
action=/bin/sh -c poweroff
